name: Steven Frank Johnson
office: City of La Verne, Member of the City Council, 1st District

items.text: Steven Frank Johnson is a member of the La Verne City Council, representing District 1 since 2022. He works as an insurance broker. During a May 2026 council meeting, Johnson said he does not think e-bikes should be on city sidewalks. In July 2026, he seconded and voted for a salary chart that gave police and fire personnel pay increases of 3 to 5 percent. He serves as vice-chair of the city's Enhanced Infrastructure Financing District board. His council delegate roles include the Southern California Association of Governments and the financial committee.
